name: taskpe
description: TaskPe's PHP app has no JavaScript build step (public/js/app.js and public/css/app.css are the sources, served as written), so `npm run build` here would be a lie and it exits non-zero on purpose. This file has two real jobs: (1) `npm run test:js` runs the SPA smoke checks; (2) it is the npm WORKSPACE ROOT for the Shopify Admin extensions in extensions/, because extensions/shared/*.jsx sits outside every extension folder and can only resolve `preact` by walking up to this node_modules. `npm install` once here - not per extension folder - so all six extensions share one hoisted copy of preact (two copies in one bundle means broken hooks).

scripts.dev: node -e "console.error('No bundler for the app. It is php artisan serve. The Admin extensions are bundled by Shopify CLI: shopify app build (after running npm install here once, so extensions/shared can resolve preact).')" && exit 1
scripts.build: node -e "console.error('Nothing to build. public/js/app.js + public/css/app.css are committed as-is. Extensions are bundled by Shopify CLI (shopify app build), not by vite.')" && exit 1
